{{Otheruses|South Pole}}
{{Quote|Our agents say that a Corellian freighter answering the description of the ''Millennium Falcon'' is hidden somewhere in the Hasamadhi warehouse district near the South Pole.|[[Guri]]|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
The '''South Pole''' was the southernmost point on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It contained huge [[Water/Legends|icecaps]] that were popular with tourists. Coruscant's [[Southern Underground/Legends|Southern Underground]] was located near the South Pole.
